basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old pastry chef based in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for sci-fi video games and cybersecurity. When I'm not baking macarons or crafting intricate desserts, I'm diving into the world of Destiny 2 or engaging in the latest scambaiting techniques to expose online fraudsters. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and sometimes during late-night gaming sessions. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring new cafes and dessert spots in my city.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a culinary arts degree and have been working in the pastry sector for the past 6 years. My interest in technology and cybersecurity developed through online courses and self-study, primarily due to my hobby of scambaiting. My gaming knowledge stems from years of playing various video games, with a particular focus on the Destiny franchise.
